claims.claim: NLI documents its filterable query attributes explicitly (start_date / end_date, language, system_number, shelfmark) plus the descriptive text attributes title, creator and publisher, and publishes no attribute named subject.
claims.raw_snippet: A query compares a text to one / few / all descriptive attributes, and can filter by start_date / end_date and/or language and/or system_number and/or shelfmark.

claims.claim: An unrecognised NLI attribute or parameter (for example subject, publication_year_from, publication_year_to) is not rejected: the condition is silently skipped, the request still returns UNFILTERED results, and the skip is reported only in an Errors response header.
claims.raw_snippet: If the Search string has a syntax error in a non-mandatory attribute, the condition is ignored and an "Errors" Header will describe the error.

claims.claim: NLI date filtering uses start_date / end_date as query clauses with the contains operator in yyyy or yyyyMMdd form; contains is a substring match on the date string and does not express a range.
claims.raw_snippet: query=title,exact,jerusalem,AND;publisher,contains,jaffa,AND;language,exact,eng,AND;system_number,exact,990023677080205171,AND;start_date, contains,1925

claims.claim: A basic NLI query must include at least a three-character string over one of the search attributes.
claims.raw_snippet: Basic queries must include at least a three character string over one of the search attributes.
